summary.tldr: Changes the Criminal Code so a mental disorder alone cannot make someone eligible for medical assistance in dying.
what_it_does: Replaces the Criminal Code rule on MAID so a mental disorder is not a grievous and irremediable medical condition.
Adds coordinating rules so this change lines up with the 2021 MAID amendment law if their coming-into-force dates overlap.
who_it_affects: People seeking medical assistance in dying
summary.background: The bill changes subsection 241.2(2.1) of the Criminal Code. It also includes coordinating amendments tied to An Act to amend the Criminal Code (medical assistance in dying), chapter 2 of the Statutes of Canada, 2021.
